Verify existence of three separable components: (1) an Encoder network class producing a latent z from (state, reward) pairs, (2) a Decoder network class predicting reward from (state, z), and (3) an IQL-based policy/value module that takes z as conditioning input alongside state. verification.spec: Call the encoder's reward-discretization function with an array of scalar rewards spanning the min/max range of a sampled reward function. Verify (a) the output dtype is integer, (b) the number of unique bin indices is at most 32, (c) values are in [0, 31], and (d) rescaling min->0 and max->31 (or 32 clipped) matches expected floor((r - r_min)/(r_max - r_min) * 32).

verification.spec: Locate the FRE encoder module and verify it contains a learned embedding table (e.g., nn.Embedding) of size (num_reward_embeddings=32, reward_embedding_dim=128) that maps discretized reward bin indices to continuous vectors. Assert the module is an embedding lookup (not an MLP) by inspecting its type and weight shape.

sub_tasks.requirements: The FRE Encoder network has been implemented such that the the environment state projected into an embedding using a learned linear transformation

verification.spec: Inspect the FRE encoder and verify the state input is projected via a learned linear layer (nn.Linear) with input dim = state_dim and output dim matching the transformer token dimension. Confirm the layer is applied before entering the transformer blocks.

sub_tasks.requirements: The FRE Encoder network has been implemented such that for each state, the reward embedding is concatenated to end of the state embedding before the set of reward-labeled states is passed through the encoder

verification.spec: Instantiate the encoder and monkey-patch or inspect the token construction step. Feed K state-reward pairs and verify that each per-token input vector to the transformer equals concat([state_embedding, reward_embedding]) along the feature dimension (i.e., token_dim = state_embed_dim + reward_embed_dim, with reward portion in the trailing dims).

sub_tasks.requirements: The FRE Encoder has been implemented such that it takes a set of states labeled with their scalar rewards as input

verification.spec: Call encoder.forward with a batch of shape (batch, K, state_dim) states and (batch, K) scalar rewards. Verify the call succeeds and returns a latent z of shape (batch, latent_dim). Also verify that permuting the order of the K pairs yields the same z (permutation invariance).

sub_tasks.requirements: The FRE Encoder has been implemented such that the transformer does not use a causal mask on its attention, such that each input token can attend to any other input token.

verification.spec: Inspect the transformer encoder implementation. Verify that no causal mask (upper triangular attention mask) is applied during attention computation — either by absence of a `mask`/`causal` argument, or by explicit `is_causal=False` / mask=None. Additionally verify by feeding an input and confirming attention weights allow every token to attend to every other token.

sub_tasks.requirements: The FRE encoder has been implemented such that positional embeddings are not used in the transformer

verification.spec: Inspect the FRE encoder module. Verify there is no positional embedding layer/module (no `pos_embed`, `PositionalEncoding`, `sinusoidal_pos_emb`, etc.) added to the input tokens before or during the transformer. Confirm token embeddings depend only on (state, reward) content, not sequence position.

verification.spec: Inspect the encoder config/hyperparameters. verification.spec: Inspect the FRE decoder implementation. Verify it is a plain feedforward MLP (a stack of Linear + activation layers, no attention/recurrence). Confirm input is (state, z) concatenation and output is a scalar predicted reward.

sub_tasks.requirements: The FRE Decoder has been implemented such that it independently predicts the reward for a single input state, given a shared latent encoding z

verification.spec: Instantiate the FRE decoder with a fixed z. Feed a batch of N different states and check the output shape is (N,1). Verify that decoder(state_i, z) equals the same output whether computed alone or as part of a batch (i.e., predictions per state are independent given shared z). Also confirm by inspecting the forward pass that no state-to-state interaction (attention, pooling) is present.

sub_tasks.requirements: The FRE Decoder has been implemented using the hyper-parameters specified in Appendix A

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented that trains a Goal-Conditioned IQL (GC-IQL) baseline on the antmaze-large-diverse-v2 dataset, using hindsight relabeling (0.2 self, 0.5 future, 0.3 random) and the same network structure/hyperparameters as FRE (batch 512, 1M steps, layers [512,512,512], AWR temp 3.0, IQL expectile 0.8), and evaluated on the ant-goal-reaching task achieving a normalized score of ~40.0 (±14) on the ant-goal-reaching evaluation.

verification.spec: Train GC-IQL on antmaze-large-diverse-v2 with hindsight goal relabeling; evaluate over 20 episodes across 5 seeds on ant-goal-reaching; assert |measured_score - 40.0| / 40.0 <= 0.35 (allowing for the reported std of ±14).

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented that trains a Goal-Conditioned Behavioral Cloning (GC-BC) baseline on the antmaze-large-diverse-v2 dataset, using the same hindsight goal-relabeling distribution and network structure as the FRE codebase, and evaluated on the ant-goal-reaching task achieving a normalized score of ~12.0 (±18).

verification.spec: Train GC-BC on antmaze-large-diverse-v2 with hindsight relabeling; evaluate over 20 episodes across 5 seeds on ant-goal-reaching; assert measured_score is within [0, 30] (paper reports 12.0 ± 18, so accept a broad tolerance around this value).

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented that trains OPAL (Offline Primitive Discovery, Ajay et al. 2020) on the antmaze-large-diverse-v2 dataset — auto-encoding trajectory chunks to learn latent skills — and evaluated on all six AntMaze tasks (goal-reaching, directional, random-simplex, path-loop, path-edges, path-center) using the privileged 10-skill online rollout selection (OPAL-10) achieving an aggregate antmaze-all normalized score of ~45.6 (±17.0).

verification.spec: Train OPAL on antmaze-large-diverse-v2; at eval, sample 10 skills, evaluate each with online rollouts, take best-performing per task; average across the 6 AntMaze eval tasks over 20 episodes and 5 seeds; assert |measured_antmaze_all - 45.6| / 45.6 <= 0.40.
